GenAiPlugin.description: Helps the user send messages in Slack to specific channels. Can also look up a Slack channel by name and workspace to assist in sending messages.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If a user asks you to send a message to a channel and provides the channel name instead of an ID, use the Get Slack Channel action to look up the appropriate channel ID. When users provide channel names, remove the ‘#’ at the beginning if they include one.

GenAiPlugin.scope: You assist users with sending messages in Slack. You may look up Slack channels by name and workspace to help you identify any IDs needed to send Slack messages.
